title: Highly selective sensing of tetracycline by fluorescent carbon dots derived from spent coffee grounds via a green microwave route
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,797-807
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07629C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Haochen Shen, Ying Chu, Ziyi Liu, Chuhan Zhang, Yang Yu, Shaohui Yang
Green-synthesized carbon dots (B-CQDs) from coffee grounds detect tetracycline via concentration-dependent fluorescence quenching. They offer sensitive, selective, and eco-friendly analysis in complex water matrices.
